title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 059 ]

blocks.text: Some people become blind because a part of the eye called the cornea doesn't let in enough light. The cornea becomes clouded over. These people can be made to see again, however, if they are able to get clear corneas to let in the light. The blind must get healthy corneas from donors—people who agree to let blind people use their corneas after they die.

readingSentences.english: Some people become blind because a part of the eye called the cornea doesn't let in enough light.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 사람들은 각막이라는 눈의 한 부분이 빛을 충분히 들여보내지 못해 시력을 잃는다.

readingSentences.english: These people can be made to see again, however, if they are able to get clear corneas to let in the light.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 빛을 들여보낼 맑은 각막을 얻을 수 있다면 이 사람들은 다시 볼 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: The blind must get healthy corneas from donors—people who agree to let blind people use their corneas after they die.
readingSentences.korean: 시각장애인은 기증자, 즉 자신이 죽은 뒤 시각장애인이 자기 각막을 쓰도록 허락한 사람들에게서 건강한 각막을 받아야 한다.
